l1_connect_account.title: Bring the GPU servers bought by teams under the platform
l1_connect_account.why: Teams run models on these GPU servers, but the platform does not see them, so their access, cost and data are nobody's job.
steps: List GPU servers from purchasing, the data centre and the teams.
Register each one with the platform with a scoped account.
Confirm utilisation and the models running show for each.
l1_connect_account.success: Every GPU server in scope reports its utilisation and its models.
